summary: Pre-market with the composite at 44.09 and a single-day trend of -0.04, the regime still goldilocks, the new information is a discount-rate retreat that does not repair the constraint: the rate block rolled to a fresh 2026-09-21 observation with the 10-year yield easing from 5.01 to 4.96 and the real rate from 2.68 to 2.62, still at the 99.6th and 99.84th percentiles, while the 2-year held at 4.76 and the 10Y/2Y curve flattened to 0.20. Against that, the cushion behind the system thinned: the reverse repo facility fell from 0.582 to 0.453, a 3.21st percentile reading scoring 93.57 on risk, while reserves rose to 3013794. Risk pricing still refuses to confirm the macro block, with VIX at 14.87 in the 21.27th percentile and high-yield OAS at 2.66 in the 5.86th, and the last completed US session was broad rather than narrow, with 21 of the 22 sector and theme rows higher and only Consumer Electronics lower at -1.2821. Asia diverged, as 7 of the 11 tracked A-share names closed lower, the worst 300475.sz at -1.1976. Policy is the binding watch into 2026-09-28, with the FedWatch implied rate at 4.16 carrying a hike action against an effective rate of 3.88.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro is the heaviest block at 69.22 and it is still rising, and it supplies the model's largest single-indicator contributions: the 10-year real rate at 2.62 contributes 4.992 points and the 10-year yield at 4.96 contributes 4.96. At the 99.84th and 99.6th percentiles respectively, the discount-rate constraint is only marginally off its cycle extreme, so the retreat is relief rather than repair.

The reverse repo facility is the third-largest contributor at 3.7428 points and it is nearly exhausted: 0.453, a 3.21st percentile reading scoring 93.57 on risk, while reserves rose to 3013794 and the Fed balance sheet edged up to 6746548. The drain is now being funded from an almost empty cushion.

Cross-asset confirmation is the largest weighted driver at 7.5 points, with the composite signal at 0.4286: 3 of the 7 measurable cross-asset checks fired, namely dollar strength at 119.5133, real-rate pressure at 2.62 and small-cap underperformance at -8.1362, while credit, copper, gold and bitcoin all stayed silent.

Policy is priced tighter than it is: the FedWatch implied rate is 4.16 with a hike action while the effective fed funds rate is 3.88, and Boston Fed President Collins backed a hike while warning inflation could stay notably above the 2 percent target. With the FOMC on 2026-09-28, a hawkish repricing is the clearest single path to a worse composite.

Equity structure is the third-heaviest block at 47.38 and it is falling, with the new-highs ratio at 0.0452 against new lows at 0.0387 and only 0.6 of the universe above its 200-day average. New highs are a 2.816-point contributor, so a narrow expansion is doing real work in the composite.

supporting_signals.claim: The rate block rolled to a fresh 2026-09-21 observation and the move was lower: the 10-year yield from 5.01 to 4.96 and the real rate from 2.68 to 2.62, with breakevens slipping too, the 5-year forward from 2.35 to 2.34 and the 10-year from 2.34 to 2.33. That is a nominal-and-real retreat rather than an inflation-expectations shock.

Credit still prices no accident: high-yield OAS at 2.66 in the 5.86th percentile and investment-grade at 0.77 in the 13.52nd, with VIX at 14.87 and realized volatility at 10.6356. The liquidity and credit block scores only 32.22 and the volatility block only 17.2, the two least-stressed blocks in the model.

The last completed US session was broad and hardware-led: 21 of the 22 sector and theme rows advanced, with Semiconductors at 4.9281, Semis Leaders at 4.1083, AI Infrastructure at 4.6307, Quantum Computing at 4.7679 and Cloud Computing at 3.8205. AMD at 9.9496 and Tesla at 3.028 led the large caps.

Non-equity risk assets are stable rather than stressed: bitcoin at 85798.0 and ether at 2731.92, with a 0.02521 daily change on bitcoin, while the dollar index at 119.5133 sits only in the 30.26th percentile. The trend block scores 42.43 with price 7.919 above the 200-day average.

Sell-side positioning is still constructive on the AI complex even as caution about model-development pace builds: a top chip analyst reiterated a bullish case on Nvidia and Broadcom, and one broker raised its Microsoft target from 530 USD to 575 USD.

contradicting_signals.claim: The relief is thin: the real rate at 2.62 remains in the 99.84th percentile and the 10-year yield at 4.96 in the 99.6th with a risk score of 99.2, and the flattening was front-end-led, as the 2-year held at 4.76 while the long end fell, compressing the 10Y/2Y curve to 0.20. A curve flattening from a high level is a growth signal, not an easing one.

Asia went the other way. Of the 11 tracked A-share names only 4 closed higher and 7 closed lower, the worst 300475.sz at -1.1976 with 002156.sz at -1.1335 and 603986.sh at -0.8406, while the layer's US hardware complex was up 4 to 5 percent. The two regions are running on separate tracks rather than transmitting to each other.

Policy risk has not receded. The FedWatch implied rate of 4.16 carries a hike action against an effective rate of 3.88, Collins backed a hike while flagging inflation as potentially notably above 2 percent, and the FOMC lands on 2026-09-28 inside the 7-day window. High discount rates and a hawkish path can coexist.

Breadth improved at the margin but remains narrow: only 0.6 of the universe is above its 200-day average, new lows at 0.0387 nearly match new highs at 0.0452, and the relative measures stay deeply negative, with semis relative at -18.5165 and small caps at -8.1362. The advance is concentrated.

The liquidity block's low score of 32.22 hides a depleted cushion: the reverse repo facility at 0.453 sits in the 3.21st percentile and scores 93.57 on risk, and the 3.7428-point top-driver contribution shows how much of the composite now rests on a nearly empty facility. Reserves at 3013794 rose, so there is no funding stress today, but little is left to absorb one.

what_changed_today: The rate and dollar blocks both repriced on a fresh 2026-09-21 observation: the 10-year yield from 5.01 to 4.96, the real rate from 2.68 to 2.62 and the 2-year unchanged at 4.76, while the dollar index rose from 119.3489 to 119.5133.
The composite moved -0.04 to 44.09 with the risk level and regime unchanged, and macro at 69.22 stayed the heaviest block.
The reverse repo facility fell from 0.582 to 0.453 while reserves rose to 3013794 and the Fed balance sheet to 6746548, so the cushion thinned as the balance sheet grew.
The CN session closed with only 4 of the 11 tracked A-share names higher and 7 lower, a mirror image of the broad US hardware advance in the same layer.
Credit tightened a second day, high-yield OAS from 2.68 to 2.66 with investment-grade unchanged at 0.77, and VIX edged from 14.81 to 14.87.
Breadth shifted modestly: the new-highs ratio from 0.0258 to 0.0452 and new lows from 0.0323 to 0.0387, with names above the 200-day average easing to 0.6.

Press flow stayed hawkish on policy and constructive on AI hardware: a top chip analyst reiterated a bullish Nvidia and Broadcom case, one broker lifted its Microsoft target to 575 USD while another cut Micron to 1400 USD.
watch_next: Whether the 10-year yield holds below 5 or re-tests it, and whether the real rate at 2.62 moves off the 99.84th percentile. A further retreat is the cleanest single way for the macro block to stop dominating.

The FOMC on 2026-09-28 and the implied path around it, with FedWatch at 4.16 carrying a hike action against an effective rate of 3.88. A dovish surprise is the clearest upside, while a delivered hike would make the 44.09 composite read too complacent.
Whether the reverse repo facility at 0.453 keeps draining toward zero and whether reserves at 3013794 start to fall with it. That combination is where funding stress would first appear.

Whether 21 of the 22 advancing sector and theme rows persist or narrow back to the AI hardware complex, and whether Semiconductors at 4.9281 outruns the -18.5165 semis relative reading that still describes the medium term.
Whether the A-share AI panel's 7 of 11 lower close reverses, given constructive sell-side framing of the US hardware complex and the domestic compute-leasing flow in the press.
The 2026-09-30 Personal Income and Outlays and GDP releases and the 2026-10-02 Employment Situation, all high importance, now that non-farm payrolls have accelerated from 21.0 to 162.0.

bull_case.title: Disinflationary ease into a broad tape
points: The rate retreat becomes a trend rather than a single print: the 10-year at 4.96 and the real rate at 2.62 keep falling while breakevens stay anchored near 2.33, so the macro block at 69.22 stops dominating the composite.

Credit and volatility keep validating the benign case, with high-yield OAS at 2.66, investment-grade at 0.77 and VIX at 14.87, so a broad 21 of 22 advancing session extends into the AI hardware complex rather than reversing.

The liquidity cushion refills rather than drains, with the reverse repo facility rebounding from 0.453 while reserves at 3013794 hold, removing the one channel that could turn a rate story into a funding story.

base_case.title: A pinned composite with a decaying cushion
points: The composite stays pinned at 44.09 with a single-day trend of -0.04, as macro at 69.22 and equity structure at 47.38 offset liquidity at 32.22 and volatility at 17.2, leaving both the risk level and the regime unchanged.

The real rate at 2.62 in the 99.84th percentile and the 10-year at 4.96 in the 99.6th keep a ceiling on multiple expansion, so breadth stays narrow with 0.6 above the 200-day average and 0.0452 making new highs.

Rates drift lower while the dollar rises from 119.3489 to 119.5133 and the reverse repo facility drains from 0.582 to 0.453, a slow tightening in conditions that never shows up in credit or volatility.

bear_case.title: A hawkish delivery into an empty cushion
points: The FOMC delivers into a market already pricing a hike, with FedWatch implied at 4.16 carrying a hike action against an effective rate of 3.88, and the 10-year yield pushes back above 5 while the real rate at 2.62 breaks beyond its 99.84th percentile.

The cushion is already gone, since the reverse repo facility at 0.453 in the 3.21st percentile and scoring 93.57 leaves reserves at 3013794 as the only buffer, so any funding wobble transmits straight into the 32.22 liquidity block.

The advance narrows back to a handful of AI hardware names, since the semis relative reading at -18.5165 and small caps at -8.1362 describe a market where only 0.0452 makes new highs, so 21 of 22 higher is breadth on paper only.
